title: Polydatin, a derivative of resveratrol, ameliorates busulfan-induced oligozoospermia in mice by inhibiting NF-kappaB pathway activation and suppressing ferroptosis.
authors: Wang, Chengniu; Li, Xiaoran; Ye, Taowen; Gu, Jiale; Zheng, Zihan; Chen, Guangtong; Dong, Jin; Zhou, Wenbiao; Shi, Jianwu; Zhang, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究虎杖苷对白消安诱导少精症的保护作用，涉及NF-kB通路与铁死亡，仅含分子对接但非蛋白-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Polydatin (PD), a glucoside derivative of resveratrol (RES), is extracted as a monomer compound from the dried rhizome of Polygonum cuspidatum. Our laboratory synthesized PD via the biotransformation of resveratrol. To assess the reproductive protective effects of PD, an oligozoospermia mouse model was induced by administering 30 mg/kg busulfan (BUS) via intraperitoneal injection. Initially, mice were categorized into groups based on PD concentrations of 10, 50, and 100 mg/kg. Subsequently, the optimal concentration of 10 mg/kg was ascertained based on testis weight and spermatological parameters. Additionally, a 10 mg/kg resveratrol group was included as a control. The findings revealed that exposure to BUS resulted in a reduction of testicular weight, diminished spermatogenic cells and epididymal sperm counts, increased sperm deformity, disordered testicular cytoskeleton, compromised blood-testis barrier integrity, and a significant decrease in serum sex hormone levels, notably testosterone. This resulted in decreased expression of androgen receptors and other testosterone-related proteins, increased levels of malondialdehyde and reactive oxygen species, and promoted testicular ferroptosis. However, PD could successfully reverse these injuries. High-throughput sequencing data demonstrated that polydatin significantly downregulated the expression of inflammatory and metabolic genes, including PRKCQ and CARD11. These proteins are pivotal in the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway during the inflammatory response. Molecular docking studies showed that PD could interact with PRKCQ and CARD11 to reduce the level of inflammation. Additionally, PD was shown to interact with the ferroptosis-promoting gene ACSL4, modulating ferroptosis. In summary, PD facilitates the reversal of BUS-induced oligozoospermia through the mitigation of oxidative stress and inflammation, the inhibition of ferroptosis, and the modulation of hormonal levels.
abstract_zh: 虎杖苷（Polydatin, PD）是白藜芦醇（resveratrol, RES）的葡萄糖苷衍生物，从虎杖干燥根茎中提取的单体化合物。本实验室通过白藜芦醇的生物转化合成了PD。为评估PD的生殖保护作用，通过腹腔注射30 mg/kg白消安（busulfan, BUS）诱导少精子症小鼠模型。首先，根据PD浓度10、50和100 mg/kg将小鼠分组。随后，基于睾丸重量和精液参数确定最佳浓度为10 mg/kg。此外，设置10 mg/kg白藜芦醇组作为对照。结果显示，暴露于BUS导致睾丸重量减少、生精细胞和附睾精子数量减少、精子畸形率增加、睾丸细胞骨架紊乱、血睾屏障完整性受损，以及血清性激素水平（尤其是睾酮）显著下降。这导致雄激素受体及其他睾酮相关蛋白表达降低，丙二醛和活性氧水平升高，并促进睾丸铁死亡。然而，PD能成功逆转这些损伤。高通量测序数据表明，虎杖苷显著下调炎症和代谢基因的表达，包括PRKCQ和CARD11。这些蛋白在炎症反应中NF-kappaB通路的激活中起关键作用。分子对接研究显示，PD能与PRKCQ和CARD11相互作用以降低炎症水平。此外，PD被证明能与促铁死亡基因ACSL4相互作用，调节铁死亡。总之，PD通过减轻氧化应激和炎症、抑制铁死亡以及调节激素水平，促进逆转BUS诱导的少精子症。
